2608.10906.title: GitSkills: A Dataset of Agent Skills on GitHub
2608.10906.paper_summary: An agent skill is a folder containing a SKILL.md file with instructions for a language-model agent, optionally accompanied by scripts and reference files. The agent loads the skill when it judges that a task matches the skill description. Anthropic introduced the format in October 2025 as an open specification. Nine months later, we find that skill files in the millions sit in public GitHub repositories. Skills are unlike the artifacts the SE research community usually mines: they are written mainly in natural language, a model selects them probabilistically at run time, and no compiler or type checker verifies the selection. They also have no central registry or package manager, so they spread by copying folders between repositories. How developers write, reuse, and maintain skills is therefore an empirical question, and no existing dataset records this population. We present GitSkills, a dataset of 3,797,117 SKILL.md files collected from 282,200 public repositories in July 2026. The dataset retains every file occurrence with its repository, path, and content hash. It groups identical files into 1,877,981 distinct contents and enriches one representative per group with the full text, parsed front matter, folder contents, repository metadata, and, for a subset, the commit history of the file. A single self- contained SQLite file supports research on the adoption, reuse, structure, authorship, maintenance, and security of agent skills.
2608.10906.paper_summary_zh: 一個代理技能是一個包含 SKILL.md 檔案的資料夾，該檔案提供語言模型代理的指令，並可選擇性地附有腳本和參考檔案。當代理判斷某項任務符合技能描述時，會加載該技能。Anthropic 在 2025 年 10 月引入了這種格式，作為一種開放規範。九個月後，我們發現數以百萬計的技能檔案存放在公共 GitHub 倉庫中。技能不同於 SE 研究社群通常挖掘的文物：它們主要以自然語言撰寫，模型在運行時以概率方式選擇它們，且沒有編譯器或類型檢查器驗證選擇。它們也沒有中央登記處或套件管理器，因此通過在倉庫之間複製資料夾進行擴散。因此，開發者如何撰寫、重用和維護技能是一個實證問題，現有的數據集並未記錄這一群體。我們呈現 GitSkills，一個包含 3,797,117 個 SKILL.md 檔案的數據集，這些檔案來自於 2026 年 7 月的 282,200 個公共倉庫。該數據集保留了每個檔案的出現，包括其倉庫、路徑和內容哈希。它將相同的檔案分組為 1,877,981 個獨特內容，並為每組豐富一個代表檔案，包含完整文本、解析的前言、資料夾內容、倉庫元數據，以及對於一部分檔案的提交歷史。一個獨立的 SQLite 檔案支持對代理技能的採用、重用、結構、作者、維護和安全性進行研究。
